title: Sum of Distances in Tree
description: Given an undirected tree with nodes numbered 0 through `n - 1`, return an array where each entry is the sum of shortest-path distances from that node to every other node.
constraints: The edges form a connected tree
hints: Use a compact state to summarize each subtree or set of chosen items.
Combine partial states and cache repeated subproblems.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public int[] sumOfDistancesInTree(int n,int[][] e) { List<Integer>[]g=new List[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)g[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[]x:e){g[x[0]].add(x[1]);g[x[1]].add(x[0]);}int[]p=new int[n],sz=new int[n],ans=new int[n],ord=new int[n];Arrays.fill(p,-1);Arrays.fill(sz,1);int k=1;ord[0]=0;for(int i=0;i<k;i++){int u=ord[i];for(int v:g[u])if(v!=p[u]){p[v]=u;ord[k++]=v;}}for(int i=n-1;i>0;i--){int u=ord[i],v=p[u];sz[v]+=sz[u];ans[v]+=ans[u]+sz[u];}for(int i=1;i<n;i++){int u=ord[i];ans[u]=ans[p[u]]-sz[u]+n-sz[u];}return ans;} }

solutionCode.python:
class Solution:
    def minCameraCover(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        # states: 0 needs camera, 1 covered, 2 has camera
        cams=0
        def dfs(n):
            nonlocal cams
            if not n:return 1
            l=dfs(n.left);r=dfs(n.right)
            if l==0 or r==0:cams+=1;return 2
            if l==2 or r==2:return 1
            return 0
        if dfs(root)==0:cams+=1
        return cams

title: Shortest Hamiltonian Tour
description: Given a complete directed graph represented by `costs[i][j]`, where travel from city `i` to city `j` costs that amount, find the minimum cost tour that starts at city 0, visits every city exactly once, and returns to city 0.
constraints: The answer fits in a signed 32-bit integer
hints: Use a compact state to summarize each subtree or set of chosen items.
Combine partial states and cache repeated subproblems.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public int shortestTour(int[][] c) { int n=c.length,N=1<<n,inf=1000000000;int[][]d=new int[N][n];for(int[]r:d)Arrays.fill(r,inf);d[1][0]=0;for(int m=1;m<N;m++)if((m&1)!=0)for(int u=0;u<n;u++)if(d[m][u]<inf)for(int v=0;v<n;v++)if((m&(1<<v))==0)d[m|1<<v][v]=Math.min(d[m|1<<v][v],d[m][u]+c[u][v]);int best=inf;for(int u=0;u<n;u++)best=Math.min(best,d[N-1][u]+c[u][0]);return best;} }

title: Can I Win
description: Players alternate choosing unused integers from 1 through `maxChoosableInteger` and add each choice to a running total. The first player to make the total reach or exceed `desiredTotal` wins. Both play optimally. Return true if the first player can force a win.
hints: Use a compact state to summarize each subtree or set of chosen items.
Combine partial states and cache repeated subproblems.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { int max;Boolean[] memo;boolean win(int mask,int rem){if(memo[mask]!=null)return memo[mask];for(int x=1;x<=max;x++){int b=1<<(x-1);if((mask&b)==0&&(x>=rem||!win(mask|b,rem-x)))return memo[mask]=true;}return memo[mask]=false;}public boolean canIWin(int m,int t){if(t<=0)return true;if(m*(m+1)/2<t)return false;max=m;memo=new Boolean[1<<m];return win(0,t);} }

title: Matchsticks to Square
description: Use every matchstick exactly once to form the four equal sides of a square. Matchsticks cannot be broken. Return true if this is possible.
hints: Use a compact state to summarize each subtree or set of chosen items.
Combine partial states and cache repeated subproblems.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { int[] a;int side;int[]s=new int[4];boolean dfs(int i){if(i==a.length)return true;Set<Integer> tried=new HashSet<>();for(int k=0;k<4;k++){if(tried.contains(s[k])||s[k]+a[i]>side)continue;tried.add(s[k]);s[k]+=a[i];if(dfs(i+1))return true;s[k]-=a[i];if(s[k]==0)return false;}return false;}public boolean makesquare(int[] x){int total=0;for(int v:x)total+=v;if(total%4!=0)return false;a=x.clone();Arrays.sort(a);for(int i=0,j=a.length-1;i<j;i++,j--){int t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}side=total/4;if(a[0]>side)return false;Arrays.fill(s,0);return dfs(0);} }
solutionCode.python:
class Solution:
    def makesquare(self, matchsticks: List[int]) -> bool:
        total=sum(matchsticks)
        if total%4:return False
        side=total//4;a=sorted(matchsticks,reverse=True)
        if a[0]>side:return False
        sums=[0]*4
        def dfs(i):
            if i==len(a):return True
            tried=set()
            for k in range(4):
                if sums[k] in tried or sums[k]+a[i]>side:continue
                tried.add(sums[k]);sums[k]+=a[i]
                if dfs(i+1):return True
                sums[k]-=a[i]
                if sums[k]==0:return False
            return False
        return dfs(0)

title: Find Shortest Superstring
description: Return a shortest string that contains every input word as a contiguous substring. If several shortest strings exist, return the lexicographically smallest. No input word is a substring of another input word.
constraints: No word is a substring of another
hints: Use a compact state to summarize each subtree or set of chosen items.
Combine partial states and cache repeated subproblems.

solutionCode.java: class Solution { public String shortestSuperstring(String[] w) { int n=w.length,N=1<<n;int[][]o=new int[n][n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)for(int j=0;j<n;j++)if(i!=j)for(int k=Math.min(w[i].length(),w[j].length());k>0;k--)if(w[i].endsWith(w[j].substring(0,k))){o[i][j]=k;break;}String[][]d=new String[N][n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)d[1<<i][i]=w[i];for(int m=1;m<N;m++)for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(d[m][i]!=null)for(int j=0;j<n;j++)if((m&(1<<j))==0){int z=m|1<<j;String c=d[m][i]+w[j].substring(o[i][j]);if(d[z][j]==null||c.length()<d[z][j].length()||(c.length()==d[z][j].length()&&c.compareTo(d[z][j])<0))d[z][j]=c;}String b=null;for(String s:d[N-1])if(s!=null&&(b==null||s.length()<b.length()||(s.length()==b.length()&&s.compareTo(b)<0)))b=s;return b;} }
